text:
priyanka: quick huddle — NovoHealth sent a prioritized list: (1) per-model cost breakdown for billing, (2) route-level error slices for support SLAs, (3) lightweight tracing hooks for correlating latency spikes. Need to decide what goes in MVP.

jon: timeline pressure from growth team — billing change rollout depends on (1). if cost missing, they'll delay.

marta: can we do cost + error first, and provide a small contract for tracing (headers + span tags) that we expand later?

samir: FYI tracing headers-only is cheap; full spans + ingest is not. propose header passthrough + a 0.5% default sample of spans for now. per-org override via config.

elaine: support wants: top-5 failing routes, error waterfall (client vs model), and example request IDs to repro. That's achievable if we store error signatures + a tiny sample of payloads for 7 days.

priyanka: acceptance criteria suggestion for MVP: 1) cost API: model-level and route-level cost per 1k tokens, 30d aggregated retention; 2) error view: route + model filters, top-5 signatures with 7d sample payloads; 3) tracing hooks: header passthrough + span_tagging (no raw trace ingest).

jon: add perf SLA: dashboard query p95 < 800ms for pre-aggregated widgets. non-negotiable for GA.

marta: on cost compute — don't compute on read. we should emit per-request metatags (model, tokens, route, cost_estimate) from the runtime and run nightly rollups into a pre-agg table. keeps dashboards fast.

samir: agree. infra caveat: we need a lightweight BFF that accepts metatags and writes to a fast timeseries store. rollups job can run hourly for 30d retention. estimate: ~0.5 RU per active org. I'll add numbers to the doc.

elaine: UX note: widgets we need for canary: 1) cost breakdown (stacked by model), 2) error-rate by route (sparkline + table), 3) latency distribution (p50/p95/p99). each widget must support quick filters (model, version, route).

priyanka: rollout plan: canary to beta orgs (NovoHealth + 3 internal teams) for 1 week, monitor dashboard perf + correctness, then 3-week gradual ramp.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary window: 1757080000 -> 1757083600

jon: what's the minimum telemetry contract for the runtime? we need a short spec so SDKs can add tags.

marta: propose this payload (HTTP header + body tags):

```
X-Redwood-Trace-Context: <trace-id>:<span-id>:<flags>
telemetry_tags: {"model.id":"gpt-4o-mini","route":"/generate","tokens":"34","cost_usd":"0.00034"}
```

samir: good. also add a small sampling config example for ops teams to tune:

```
sampling.default_rate: 0.005
sampling.per_org: {"novohealth": 0.02}
span_tags.include: ["model.id","route","region","customer_tier"]
```

elaine: can we hide raw payloads behind a support role check? we'll only surface 7-day samples to support+se.

marta: yes. PII note: strip user_text fields unless customer explicitly opts-in. add redaction rules.

priyanka: owners: Marta = telemetry contract + runtime tags; Samir = infra ingest + rollups; Elaine = dashboard UX + acceptance tests; Jon = rollout + GA gating. I'll draft cards.

jon: gating checklist for GA: 1) query perf within budget, 2) cost numbers match billing with <1% discrepancy in canary, 3) error signatures present for support flows, 4) privacy redaction validated.

priyanka: sounds good. last question: any absolute "must ship" for MVP?

marta: must ship cost API and error table. tracing can be opt-in per org.

samir: infra ok with opt-in sampling at first.

priyanka: OK closing — MVP trimmed to cost + error analytics + opt-in tracing hooks. follow-up doc to scope full-trace ingest, long-term retention, and advanced sampling strategies for phase 2.
